CORRECTION [selftrain]: Authors are Jiajia Li, Dong Chen, Xunyuan Yin and Zhaojian Li. The numbers match: CWD12 83.43 vs 86.47 and CWD3 47.93 vs 62.80. The EMA teacher (alpha 0.99), the classification score used instead of centerness, and the uncertainty-gated regression loss are all confirmed.
RESULT [weeds]: With 10% labelled data, reached about 96% of fully supervised performance on CottonWeedDet12, but only about 76% on CottonWeedDet3.
US [weeds]: On cwd12, 10% of labels recovers most of the performance, which is consistent with our Phase-A labeller result (61 exemplars). How well it transfers depends heavily on the dataset (76% on cwd3), so a labeller win on cwd12 should not be assumed on harvested data without per-source checks.
CORRECTION [weeds]: Confirmed: FCOS and Faster R-CNN student-teacher; with 10% labels, about 96% on CottonWeedDet12 and about 76% on CottonWeedDet3.
